messages:
Rachel: Heads-up 4 can we add a short "telemetry + console filters" mini-section to the Dedicated provisioning docs? Customers ask how to triage when some requests are routed to fallback variants. Need quick Console queries and one CLI log example. cc @marco @kevin

Marco: +1. I can write 3 one-liners: a Console filter (for UI), a logs CLI query, and a Prometheus-style metric example for our internal runbooks.

Kevin: Nice. Make sure we explain the four things to check: tenant labels, scalePolicy.fallback_policy, reserved capacity usage, and regional routing/failover. Keep it short.

docs-bot: Draft PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5588  WIP  adds telemetry examples and console filters.

Rachel: Proposed Console filter examples (copyable):
- Console quick filter (UI search bar): tenant:acme-corp AND routing.variant:fallback
- Console time-series filter: model:rdl-large-v1 AND region:us-west-2 AND fallback:true

Marco: Logs/CLI snippet (redwoodctl):
```bash
# fetch recent requests that used a fallback variant for tenant acme-corp
redwoodctl logs query --tenant acme-corp --filter 'routing.variant=fallback' --last 1h
```

Marco: Prometheus/Grafana metric idea (for docs only):
- metric: redwood_inference_requests_fallback_total{tenant="acme-corp",model="rdl-large-v1"}
- panel suggestion: stacked bar of fallback pct vs native model per minute

infra-ella: Ops caveats to mention in the doc: (1) retention: fallback traces are short-lived in debug retention; advise enabling higher retention for migration windows. (2) sampling: tracing may sample fallback paths less aggressively; add instruction to toggle full-trace for a tenant briefly.

Rachel: Good call. I'll add a tiny note: "If you need per-request traces, enable full-trace for the tenant for 15-30m and reproduce." Link to internal tracing toggle: https://console.redwood/internal/tracing-toggle (internal).

Kevin: Also add a one-liner about billing: routed-to-fallback still counts toward tenant usage and billing; it may use a different per-token price. That avoids confusions.

Marco: Quick troubleshooting FAQ bullet to include: "Why did 30% of my requests go to fallback?" -> Answer: check fallback_policy.max_fallback_pct, check reserved capacity utilization (dashboard), and confirm per-request routing_preferences didn't opt-out.

Rachel: I'll draft the PR text with the UI filters, CLI, metric, and FAQ bullet. Keep it ~6 lines so it's a micro-section inside the provisioning guide.

docs-bot: PR updated with micro-section. Reviewers requested: @marco @kevin @infra-ella

infra-ella: One more ops note: recommend a default debug retention and the chart to look at: "ReservedCapacityUtilization" vs "FallbackPct". Also mention cross-region failover can show as fallback in the tenant view if the model variant in failover region differs.

Kevin: LGTM. If wording is tight I'll approve. Please ensure the Console filter examples are copy-paste friendly (no smart quotes).

Rachel: Will clean up and merge after approvals. Thanks!
